Method of Attack: Uses benign apps as droppers to infect devices
Contacts remote command-and-control server to download secondary apps containing malware
Disguises second-stage app as system-level app
Uses fake security alerts to trick users into installing second app and granting admin rights
Shows intrusive ads on infected phones
Steals Facebook credentials by loading real Facebook login page inside native Android headless browser components with malicious JavaScript to harvest credentials
Attack Vector: Installation of clean apps with legitimate features acting as droppers
User installation of secondary malicious app after fake security alerts
